do_not_try: Do not present host inference or the Nagi target compile as guest inference.
Do not cite the shared repository CI as provider evidence; it does not build this standalone crate.
Do not edit shared files (registry, CI, models.lock, sources.lock, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, implementation_status) from this branch; propose diffs only.
Do not widen the shared branch schema to admit hark/m24-embedding.
Do not route this model through the pinned llama.cpp: its BertModel path builds a WordPiece vocab and cannot tokenize the XLM-R SentencePiece Unigram vocabulary.
Do not treat a green hark-m24-embedding.yml run as owner registration, guest evidence or acceptance; status stays PARTIAL while the workstream is unregistered and guest inference has not run.

Do not loosen the cross-architecture reference-vector thresholds (cosine >= 0.999999, max |diff| <= 1e-5) or apply them to semantic-ranking acceptance, model integrity or guest gates; a result beyond a bound is a FAIL to investigate.

acceptance_criteria: Implements nagi_search::semantic::EmbeddingProvider read-only by path, with query/passage prefixes and an EmbeddingSpaceId derived from the converted artifact digest and the pooling/normalization/prefix scheme.
Pinned immutable upstream revision, SHA-256 for weights, tokenizer, config and the converted artifact, all mutually consistent (verify_pins.py).
Bounded failures: empty input, byte caps, 512-token cap without silent truncation, artifact size cap, checksum pin, structural validation, no panics on malformed artifacts.
Cooperative end-to-end deadline and cancellation with documented checkpoints and guarantees; default budget enabled.
Token and vector parity with the upstream reference and Japanese/English neighbor tests on real inference.
Reference data reproducible from hash-pinned Python dependencies.

Cross-architecture reference vectors: texts and token ids exact, tokenizer_parity.json byte-identical, worst cosine >= 0.999999 AND worst max |diff| <= 1e-5, pinned artifacts and .nemb conversion digest unchanged; fixed thresholds, beyond a bound = FAIL and investigate, never loosen.
fmt, Clippy (std and no_std) and the Nagi user-target build pass.
Real inference inside a Nagi guest (not yet run).
